text: This report recommends the Board approve of travel expenses for Craig Shepherd, Facility Services Manager, and Justin Sweeney, IT/Telecommunications Manager, to attend the International Association of Venue Managers (IAVM), Venue Management School (VMS), first year member program.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Authorized travel expenses for Craig Shepherd, Facility Services Manager, and Justin Sweeney, IT/Telecommunications Manager, to attend the International Association of Venue Managers in Tampa Bay Florida, June 2022 at a cost not expected to exceed $4,500.00 for each person for registration, flights, accommodation, and incidental expenses.
